captions.caption: A man in a blue shirt stands in a hop yard and speaks to the camera.
The man gestures towards the tall rows of hop plants behind him.
He explains the trellis design for growing hops in his farm.
The man points upwards to emphasize the height of the trellis system.
He describes using two strings per plant as he gestures with his hands.
The man continues his explanation, looking directly into the camera lens.
He uses hand motions to illustrate the layout of the hop hills.
The man smiles while standing between rows of green hop plants.
He points to his chest and then gestures towards the hop yard around him.
The man concludes his intro, ready to show the trellis details.
A title card with the words "Farm Marketing Solutions" appears on screen.
The word "Farm" is displayed in a bold, dark font against a gray background.
The word "Marketing" appears below "Farm" on the title screen.
The word "Solutions" completes the company name on the title card.
A green logo featuring a barn and the company name rotates into the frame.
The "Farm Marketing Solutions" logo is shown in its full, upright position.
The camera shows a view from inside a row of hop plants in the field.
A low shot shows the grassy ground between the rows of hop plants.
The camera pans up, following the hop vines climbing the trellis strings.
Tall hop plants are seen growing upwards on thin strings towards the sky.
The camera looks up at the top wires of the trellis system.
A wide shot captures multiple rows of hop trellises and support poles.
The camera focuses on a wooden pole and the wires connected at its top.
The view shifts back to the lush green foliage of the hop plants.
A finger points towards the base of the hop hills on the ground.
The finger tracks along the row, pointing out individual hop hills.
The shot emphasizes the spacing of the plants in the grassy row.
The camera tilts up to show the two strings of coir used for each plant.
The V-shaped arrangement of the trellis strings is clearly visible.
The camera pans across the top of the hop yard, showing the wires.
Rows of hop vines on coir strings create a dense, green corridor.
The high-angle view shows the top of the trellis system against the sky.
The camera focuses on where the strings attach to the horizontal trellis wires.
The overall structure of the hop yard with its poles and wires is shown.
A hand points to a specific pole to indicate the start of a measurement.
The hand points to the next pole, showing the 12-foot spacing between them.
Two fingers are held up to represent the distance between the support poles.
The camera focuses on the top of a pole with several wires attached.
A finger points to the top of the pole, highlighting the trellis construction.
The shot shows the network of wires at the top of the hop trellis.
The finger points out different sections of the overhead wire system.
The camera shows the 3-foot spacing of wires from the central pole.
The camera pans across the wires, demonstrating the systematic layout.
The height and complexity of the overhead wire system are emphasized.
The camera moves through the hop yard, providing a view between rows.
Close-up details of hop vines and leaves on the strings are shown.
The camera looks upwards through the green foliage toward the sky.
A finger points out the specific spacing intervals along the top wire.
The top trellis wire and the strings hanging in a V-shape are shown.
The camera pans along the length of the trellis wire, showing the pattern.
The base of the hop plants is shown again, with strings forming a V.
The camera follows the hop vines as they grow upwards on the strings.
The shot captures the perspective of moving through a row of hops.
The camera quickly passes several hop plants, showing the row's length.
A close-up view shows hop cones hanging from the vines as the camera moves.
The camera pans towards the edge of the hop yard, showing a pole and trees.
The view focuses on the end pole of a trellis row at the field's edge.
The camera moves closer to the end pole, showing the anchoring of wires.
A close-up shot shows wires and strings attached to the top of the end pole.
The camera pans around the end pole, showing the surrounding farm area.
